lessonsIntro: New Wave Surf School is based right on Lossiemouth East Beach, with a surf hut, changing rooms and a board store.

text: East Beach is the long stretch of sand on the far side of the River Lossie footbridge. Lessons run from New Wave's surf hut there. It's a sheltered stretch of the Moray Firth that only gets waves when a decent north or north-east swell comes in, so on many days it's small and gentle, which suits learners well. Kids' summer camps run here in the holidays.

We couldn't confirm any lifeguard cover on East Beach, so beginners should go with the school rather than on their own. Take care around the river mouth at the western end, where the water moves faster. In winter the surf can be bigger, and the school also uses other Moray beaches, such as Hopeman and Cullen, when they suit the conditions better.

cards.label: Level
cards.title: Beginner-friendly
cards.text: Small, gentle waves are typical, and the school is based right on the beach.

cards.label: Best time
cards.title: Summer for learning
cards.text: Summer surf camps and lessons run then. Bigger swells come in autumn and winter.

cards.label: Watch out for
cards.title: River mouth, no lifeguards
cards.text: Keep away from the River Lossie outflow. We couldn't confirm any lifeguard cover.

hireIntro: You can hire kit right on the beach from New Wave's surf hut at East Beach.

text: Most days here suit a large foam board or longboard, because the Moray Firth waves are usually small. Paddleboarding works well on flat days, and New Wave teaches SUP too. The water is cold for much of the year. A 5/4mm wetsuit with boots is sensible from autumn to spring, and a 4/3mm is usually enough in summer.

cards.label: Board
cards.title: Longboard or foamie
cards.text: Extra volume makes the most of small Moray Firth waves.

cards.label: Wetsuit
cards.title: 4/3mm summer, 5/4mm winter
cards.text: Add boots, gloves and a hood in the coldest months.

cards.title: SUP on flat days

shopsIntro: We couldn't confirm a dedicated surf shop in Lossiemouth, so New Wave's hut at East Beach is your main local option.
shopsText: New Wave's surf hut on East Beach handles hire and lessons, but we couldn't find a separate surf retail shop in Lossiemouth. For buying boards or wetsuits, look further afield in Moray or Aberdeen, or ask New Wave for advice.
